summary: Validated the XPRIZE jury demo account end-to-end: idempotent seed (5 team / 5 projects / 6 invoices), login bypass (stage='ok' with no 2FA gate), Enterprise Advanced flags, demo data endpoints, is_demo cannot be injected via signup, workspace isolation for non-demo users, founder regression (TOTP stale → email-2FA used). Frontend: /dashboard greeting shows 'XPRIZE', /dashboard/projects renders 5 demo rows with progress bars (AI Caption=100%), /dashboard/finance shows €61,440 / €13,980 / €47,460 + 6 invoices (Sable=Sent, Northwind=Overdue), /dashboard/team shows 6 members at L10/L9/L7/L5/L3/L1 with correct roles + invited status for Nina. Added /app/backend/tests/test_jury_demo.py (10 tests, all pass). Full pytest regression: 116 passed + 1 skipped (baseline 106 + 10 new = 116, exactly as expected).

minor.issue: Documented TOTP secret CGONDSXBH34RCLJEZVW7ZTHNOGQI5UNZ in /app/memory/test_credentials.md still does NOT match the founder's actual DB secret. Carried over from iter11 — email-2FA path works (code lifted from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). Out of scope for this iteration.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Rotate the founder TOTP secret back to the documented value OR update /app/memory/test_credentials.md with the current secret — same drift flagged in iter11.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1749 lines (was 1609). The jury-demo seed (~110 lines) and the two /api/demo/* endpoints could move into a dedicated `demo_seed.py` module — keeps server.py focused on auth/AI/Stripe.

seed_jury_demo() force-resets the user doc on every boot (`await db.users.update_one({...}, {'$set': base_doc})`). This means any in-app changes a juror makes to their profile (name, company, role) are wiped on next backend restart — that's intentional but worth a comment in the function.

Demo data is keyed by `workspace_owner=user_id` of the jury user only. If a future demo seed adds a second demo user (e.g. partner demo), each will need its own owner — the model already supports that, but `/api/demo/projects` is implicitly scoped to the *current* user, so a non-demo user always sees an empty list (verified). Good isolation by construction.

DemoInvoices / DemoProjects in ModulePlaceholder.jsx do not surface a user-facing error if the GET fails — they silently flip `loading=false` with an empty list. For a jury demo this is fine, but consider adding a small 'Unable to load demo data' chip for future resilience.

ModulePlaceholder.jsx is now 239 lines and mixes Construction placeholder + two full data pages. Once the real Projects/Finance modules ship, split DemoProjects/DemoInvoices into their own files so the placeholder can stay tiny.

The /api/demo/projects sort is `due ASC` (matches spec). /api/demo/invoices sorts by `issued DESC` — that wasn't explicit in the spec but is the natural finance-page ordering and the UI renders correctly with it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, dashboard, projects, finance, team all rendered correctly with all required data)

test_credentials: DEMO: jury@zynthoro.ai / ZynthoroDemo2026! (no 2FA, lands on /dashboard). FOUNDER: regie@myrootzz.com / Zynthoro2026! — TOTP secret in test_credentials.md is STALE; use email-2FA path (code in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log as '2FA email code: NNNNNN').
seed_data_creation: Backend seeded by startup hook: user jury@zynthoro.ai + 5 team_members + 5 demo_projects + 6 demo_invoices, all keyed by workspace_owner=jury.id. Verified idempotent across two consecutive `supervisorctl restart backend` cycles (counts stay 5/5/6). Tests create transient TEST_demoreg_* / TEST_inject_* users but do not clean them up — they are harmless and isolated by the unique TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: When testing the /dashboard/finance demo page, allow ~3-4 seconds AFTER `wait_for_selector('demo-invoices-page')` before scraping inner_text — the GET /api/demo/invoices fetch fires inside useEffect and the initial render shows 'Loading demo invoices…' with €0 stat pills. Don't mistake that for a bug (I did initially). Same for projects but its fetch happens to resolve faster. For backend regression after any future seed-related change, run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_jury_demo.py -v` — it covers login bypass, is_demo injection hardening (signup ignores `is_demo:true` in payload — Pydantic strips it), demo endpoints, team levels, isolation, and idempotency in one shot. The founder TOTP drift persists from iter11 — email-2FA path is the documented workaround. Full suite takes ~140s (over the 120s default bash timeout) — run with timeout=300 or split by file.
rca of the issue: No bugs in scope. The single transient false-positive (finance page appeared blank in first browser pass) was a test-timing artefact — fetch had not resolved before inner_text scrape; confirmed working with a 4s wait. Founder TOTP mismatch is a pre-existing credential drift (iter11) and does not block the regression test (email-2FA path succeeded and confirmed is_demo=None, plan='Enterprise Unlimited', /api/demo/* returns empty lists for the founder).
